notes: Godot 4.7 rhythm skate game for Game Off 2026 (Learn to Ride plus three tracks, Space/Shift timing). Silkscreen is SIL OFL 1.1 (OFL text bundled). Art is code-drawn placeholders; music and SFX are synthesised in-tree (CREDITS.md). icon.svg is an original teal cat-on-skateboard mark (md5 d8d947231bad50066e2c7299f96d9694), not the Godot default; config/icon was added in this snapshot because upstream had no icon. No Git LFS, no addons, no editor .tmp.
